verdict.rationale: cubic's privacy docs say its AI model providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) contractually commit not to train on customer code snippets or metadata. Organizations can also ask to block AI features for their workspace entirely. The commitment covers third-party providers only, and the evidence does not state cubic's own policy on training with customer data. missing for 10: explicit statement on cubic's own training use, a self-serve training opt-out control, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Our AI model providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) contractually commit that code snippets and metadata passed through their APIs are not used to train or improve their underlying models.
